content.short: Optimism ETH Faucet lets users earn Optimism ETH by bridging USDC to Optimism.
content.description: Optimism ETH Faucet, a dApp on the Optimism network, enables new users to start using Optimism with a single transaction. By bridging 1,500 USDC via the faucet, users receive 0.002 oETH to cover gas fees on the Optimism layer-2 network. This tool is designed to help DeFi traders begin trading with leverage on Perpetual Protocol or other Optimism-based dApps, removing the initial gas hurdle and smoothing early activity in the ecosystem.
